name: verify_store_returns_to_active_store
question: Are all active store returns mapped to exactly one active store?
sql:
SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, COUNT(s_.s_store_sk) AS store_map_count
FROM store_returns sr
LEFT JOIN store s ON sr.sr_returning_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND sr.sr_returning_customer_sk = s.s_store_sk AND s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk
HAVING store_map_count = 1;

name: template_avg_weekly_net_profit_per_store
question: Compute the average weekly net profit per store from catalog sales with completed shipping.
sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT s.s_store_sk, AVG(cs.ws_net_profit) as avg_weekly_profit
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN store s ON cs.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  GROUP BY s.s_store_sk
)
SELECT AVG(avg_weekly_profit) AS avg_weekly_net_profit_per_store FROM weekly;
